rule: label_preserving = within clean-run noise for ours on real150 AND synth100 (median |drift| <= floor+0.5pp, p90 <= floor+2pp, P(>10%) <= floor+2pp, |median signed drift| <= 1%); floor = pooled JPEG-q95 re-encode + 0.5-px shift; size-changing transforms use max(floor, size-matched floor). legacy-13 drift is reported only and never enters this rule.

excluded.elastic: Elastic / grid-distortion warps move yarns by a spatially varying field: local yarn spacing (the quantity being labelled) changes non-uniformly, so a per-tile density label no longer exists, and yarn curvature that is not in the fabric is introduced.  Only the whole-row integral of the crossing count survives, which is useless for tile-level training.
excluded.mixup: Mixup across fabrics superimposes two yarn lattices: the image has two (h, v) pairs and two weaves, and a convex combination of the labels is not the count of anything a counter or a person would measure.
excluded.cutmix: CutMix pastes a second fabric: the count along a guide line becomes a mixture weighted by where the line runs, tile labels are undefined near the seam, and the weave label is ambiguous.
excluded.strong_blur: Blur with sigma comparable to the yarn pitch (MTF at the yarn frequency exp(-2 pi^2 sigma^2 / pitch^2) < ~0.1 for sigma > 0.35 pitch) erases the yarns: the label is unchanged in principle but no longer observable, so it becomes label noise.
excluded.label_agnostic_resized_crop: torchvision-style RandomResizedCrop / aspect-ratio jitter WITHOUT updating the physical extent silently rescales the per-inch density (a 0.7-inch window resized to the full frame reads as 0.7x the true TPI).  Use zoom() / zoom_xy(), which carry the extent.
excluded.large_rotation: Rotations beyond ~15 deg (on top of the fabric's own tilt) make the axis-count definition ambiguous (crossing count = density cos(tilt) drifts by > 3 %) and leave the near-axis search range of the counters; 90-degree multiples are handled exactly by rot90/rot270.

notes: policy (tier A) is the default of augment.load_policy(); policy_extended adds tier B.

Tier B rotations are unbiased (ours median signed drift <= 0.16 %) but both instruments lose accuracy vs the exactly transformed synthetic label as the angle grows (see evidence.*.exact_label_d_acc10_pp); at +-5 deg the CNN's change includes 0, at +-10 deg it does not. Start training at +-5 deg.
Zoom-out keeps the label only while yarns stay resolved: require >= 6 output px per yarn (policy_extended.zoom.min_px_per_thread; aug_verify/bins_px_per_thread.csv).
Physical tiles are tier C only because ours reads 0.5-inch tiles 1.5 % low on real crops (synthetic: -0.3 %, CNN: +0.1 %); the label map itself is exact (test_augment.py).

The existing synthetic-only CNN is NOT invariant to several exactly label-preserving transforms (rot90: median per-axis change 5.8 %, contrast 0.6: +4.5 % bias on real-150), which is the case for training with them.
legacy-13 drift is in augment_verification.csv for transparency and was never used for any decision.
